stories.title: Blades Brown Wins World Wide Technology Championship at Age 19 — Youngest PGA Tour Winner in 88+ Years

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Blades Brown is 19 years old.

He just won the World Wide Technology Championship on the PGA Tour in a playoff over Ben James.

His winner's check: $1,080,000. His first Tour title.

The youngest PGA Tour winner in at least 88 years.

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
The World Wide Technology Championship came down to a playoff.

Blades Brown vs. Ben James. Both at 23-under.

Hole 2 of sudden death: James missed a birdie putt inside 8 feet. Brown made birdie.

A 19-year-old just won on Tour. First career win.

article.headline: Blades Brown, 19, Wins World Wide Technology Championship — Youngest PGA Tour Winner in 88+ Years

stories.title: Ben James Runner-Up at World Wide Technology Championship — Missed Birdie Putt Proves Costly

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Ben James was 8 feet from a PGA Tour win on Sunday.

He missed. Blades Brown made his birdie on the same hole. That was the difference in the World Wide Technology Championship playoff.

Inside 8 feet. Heartbreaking miss.

article.headline: Ben James's Missed Birdie from 8 Feet Sends World Wide Technology Championship to Blades Brown

stories.title: Shuri Sakuma Wins TOTO Japan Classic — First LPGA Title

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Shuri Sakuma wins the TOTO Japan Classic — her first LPGA Tour title.

A dominant win on home soil. Final-round 64. Four strokes clear of the field.

Aki Iwai 2nd. Rookie Erika Hara 3rd in a career-best finish.

article.headline: Shuri Sakuma Wins TOTO Japan Classic for First LPGA Title, Beats Field by 4 Strokes

stories.title: LIV Golf Announces Court-Supervised Restructuring as 2026 Season Ends

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf has announced a Court-Supervised Restructuring Process.

The 2026 season ended August 30. Jon Rahm won the individual points title. Bryson DeChambeau was 2nd.

The future of the league is uncertain.
